closeout.summary: Updated only AOS Card 009 Face 1 as directed: removed the YEAR / MAKE / MODEL row, returned its height to RELATIONSHIPS, enlarged SERIAL # / HOURS / STATUS values, widened Serial, and narrowed Hours.

editResults.result: The unnecessary YEAR / MAKE / MODEL line is removed. RELATIONSHIPS expands into the freed space. SERIAL #, HOURS, and STATUS values use the deleted row's 8px value size; headers remain unchanged; Serial is wider and Hours is narrower.

tests: Vercel production deployment dpl_EJZEoqmsdvWUfm2xofcczGutK3yW for merge d89c516f1fdd9c2b33c902a6ec06ea2e03ea2dab: READY.

closeout.before: Card 009 displayed a 48px YEAR / MAKE / MODEL row above a cramped equal-width SERIAL # / HOURS / STATUS row with 6.5px values, limiting serial-number visibility and relationship space.
closeout.after: Card 009 no longer displays YEAR / MAKE / MODEL. RELATIONSHIPS receives the released height. The remaining SERIAL # / HOURS / STATUS row preserves its 4.5px headers, uses 8px values, and allocates more width to Serial and less to Hours.
notes: No Card 009 shell, media, commands, rail, editor, data contract, permissions, or sharing behavior was changed.
A broader pre-existing FaceLab admission test still expects Cards 001–003 to be blocked even though current main marks them ready; this patch did not touch that stale registry assertion.
